description: Use this when someone asks who is on their Imagelato team and what role each person has. Returns each member's display name and roles, 25 per page by default (no emails, phone numbers or user ids). Not for inviting or removing members.

cursor.description: The nextCursor of the previous page with the same filters; absent for the first page

limit.description: Results per page, from 1 to 100; defaults to 25

name: list_team_members

items.description: Display name and roles only. Email addresses, user ids, phone numbers, location, avatars, device provenance and ownership fields are excluded.

nextCursor.description: Cursor for the next page; null on the last page

title: List team members and roles
